create_gigaword_dataset: create a Gigaword dataset instance for text summarization tasks
load_gigaword_dataset: load the gigaword HuggingFace dataset using datasets.load_dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input output tuples
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training dev and test splits with a given seed
run_gigaword_preprocessing: run the main function to preprocess gigaword data for multiple seeds
